title: MCCS Free Barracks Wi-Fi
intro: Stay connected to what matters. Free barracks Wi-Fi just got a major upgrade. MCCS, in partnership with MCICOM, is now providing eligible Marines in participating barracks aboard Camp Lejeune and MCAS New River with download speeds of up to 100 Mbps, up from the previous 1 Mbps service, at no cost.

sections.markdown:
Stay connected with family and friends, take an online class, stream your favorites, game with friends, or enjoy your downtime.

• Up to 100 Mbps download speeds
• Up to 20 Mbps upload speeds
• Free filtered Wi-Fi
• No monthly cost

sections.heading: CONNECTION IS PART OF TOTAL FITNESS
sections.markdown:
Wi-Fi does more than help you get online. It helps you stay connected to family, friends, and the people who matter most.

Marine Corps Total Fitness recognizes Social Fitness as an important part of overall well-being. Staying connected can help strengthen relationships, support systems, and a sense of belonging. [Learn more about Marine Corps Total Fitness and Social Fitness](https://lejeunenewriver.usmc-mccs.org/news/why-marine-corps-total-fitness).

sections.heading: GETTING CONNECTED IS EASY
sections.markdown:
1. From inside a participating barracks, select the MCCS Free WiFi network on your device.
2. Open your web browser.
3. Follow the on-screen instructions to create your free account.

Each free account supports up to three devices.

NEED TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE? Boingo 24/7 Customer Support: 1-866-726-4646.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
sections.markdown:
**Who is eligible?**
Eligible Marines residing in participating barracks; availability varies by location.

**How much does it cost?**
The complimentary service is provided at no cost to eligible Marines.

**Can I connect multiple devices?**
Yes, up to three per free account.

**Can I use my account elsewhere?**
Yes, at participating Marine Corps installations when connected to MCCS Free WiFi.

**What if I cannot connect?**
Verify that you are inside a participating barracks, connected to MCCS Free WiFi and following registration prompts.
